description: HOLE-style axial pore radius profile through the transmembrane region of the PTM1 AlphaFold model, TMEM87A (8CTJ), bovine rhodopsin (1U19, non-pore control) and KcsA (1BL8, true channel pore positive control), to test whether the PTM1 internal cavity is a continuous membrane-spanning conduit or a cavity closed at one end
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
 'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W',
 'TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
VDW={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80,'P':1.80,'SE':1.90}

def parse_txt(txt, chains=None, resmin=None):
    rows=[]
    for line in txt.splitlines():
        if not line.startswith(('ATOM  ','HETATM')): continue
        rn=line[17:20].strip()
        if rn not in AA3: continue
        ch=line[21]
        if chains and ch not in chains: continue
        if line[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
        try: resi=int(line[22:26])
        except: continue
        if resmin is not None and resi<resmin: continue
        nm=line[12:16].strip(); el=(line[76:78].strip() or nm[0]).upper()
        if el=='H' or el=='D': continue
        rows.append((ch,resi,nm,el,float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['ch','resi','atom','el','x','y','z'])

def get(url): 
    r=requests.get(url,timeout=90); r.raise_for_status(); return r.text

# ---- structures and their TM helix definitions (chain, start, end) ----
af=requests.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/P32857',timeout=90).json()
ptm1_txt=get(af[0]['pdbUrl'])
S={}
S['PTM1 (AF P32857)']=dict(df=parse_txt(ptm1_txt,resmin=27),
    tm=[('A',198,218),('A',231,251),('A',266,286),('A',305,325),('A',334,354),('A',382,402),('A',418,438)])
S['TMEM87A (8CTJ)']=dict(df=parse_txt(get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/8CTJ.pdb'),chains={'A'}),
    tm=[('A',229,249),('A',262,282),('A',297,317),('A',330,350),('A',359,379),('A',407,427),('A',439,459)])
S['Rhodopsin (1U19)']=dict(df=parse_txt(get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/1U19.pdb'),chains={'A'}),
    tm=[('A',35,64),('A',71,100),('A',107,139),('A',151,173),('A',200,225),('A',247,277),('A',286,309)])
kc=parse_txt(get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/1BL8.pdb'),chains={'A','B','C','D'})
S['KcsA channel (1BL8)']=dict(df=kc, tm=[(c,23,51) for c in 'ABCD']+[(c,86,119) for c in 'ABCD'])

def helix_axis(df,tm):
    vs=[]
    for ch,a,b in tm:
        s=df[(df.ch==ch)&(df.atom=='CA')&(df.resi.between(a,b))].sort_values('resi')
        if len(s)<5: continue
        v=s[['x','y','z']].values[-1]-s[['x','y','z']].values[0]
        vs.append(v/np.linalg.norm(v))
    vs=np.array(vs); ref=vs[0]
    vs=np.array([v if v@ref>0 else -v for v in vs])
    ax=vs.mean(0); return ax/np.linalg.norm(ax)

def profile(df,tm,step=1.0,rad=18.0,nsect=12,sect_cut=20.0):
    X=df[['x','y','z']].values
    rv=np.array([VDW.get(e,1.7) for e in df.el.values])
    ax=helix_axis(df,tm)
    tmca=np.vstack([df[(df.ch==c)&(df.atom=='CA')&(df.resi.between(a,b))][['x','y','z']].values for c,a,b in tm])
    cen=tmca.mean(0)
    # orthonormal basis perpendicular to axis
    tmp=np.array([1.,0.,0.]) if abs(ax[0])<0.9 else np.array([0.,1.,0.])
    e1=np.cross(ax,tmp); e1/=np.linalg.norm(e1); e2=np.cross(ax,e1)
    zc=(X-cen)@ax; zt=(tmca-cen)@ax
    zlo,zhi=np.percentile(zt,5),np.percentile(zt,95)
    tree=cKDTree(X)
    g=np.arange(-rad,rad+1e-9,step); U,V=np.meshgrid(g,g); UV=np.c_[U.ravel(),V.ravel()]
    UV=UV[np.linalg.norm(UV,axis=1)<=rad]
    zs=np.arange(zlo,zhi+1e-9,step); out=[]
    for z in zs:
        P=cen+np.outer(UV[:,0],e1)+np.outer(UV[:,1],e2)+z*ax
        d,i=tree.query(P,k=25)
        r=(d-rv[i]).min(1)
        keep=r>=0.6
        if keep.sum()==0: out.append(0.0); continue
        Pk,rk,UVk=P[keep],r[keep],UV[keep]
        slab=np.abs(zc-z)<=6.0
        A=UV_atoms=np.c_[(X[slab]-cen)@e1,(X[slab]-cen)@e2]
        best=0.0
        order=np.argsort(-rk)
        for j in order[:400]:                      # test enclosure of the widest free points first
            D=A-UVk[j]; dist=np.linalg.norm(D,axis=1); m=dist<=sect_cut
            if m.sum()<nsect: continue
            sec=((np.arctan2(D[m,1],D[m,0])+np.pi)/(2*np.pi)*nsect).astype(int)%nsect
            if len(np.unique(sec))==nsect:
                best=rk[j]; break
        out.append(best)
    return zs,np.array(out),(zlo,zhi)

res={}
for k,v in S.items():
    zs,r,span=profile(v['df'],v['tm'])
    res[k]=(zs,r,span)
    mid=(zs>np.percentile(zs,15))&(zs<np.percentile(zs,85))
    print(f"{k:22s} span {span[1]-span[0]:5.1f} A  min_r(core) {r[mid].min():4.2f}  "
          f"max_r {r.max():4.2f}  frac z with r>=1.4: {np.mean(r>=1.4):.2f}  "
          f"frac z with r>=0.6: {np.mean(r>=0.6):.2f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,1,figsize=(7.2,4.6))
cols={'PTM1 (AF P32857)':'#1f77b4','TMEM87A (8CTJ)':'#2ca02c','Rhodopsin (1U19)':'#7f7f7f','KcsA channel (1BL8)':'#d62728'}
for k,(zs,r,span) in res.items():
    ax.plot(zs-zs.mean(),r,lw=2,color=cols[k],label=k)
ax.axhline(1.4,ls='--',c='k',lw=1); ax.text(-14,1.5,'1.4 A water probe',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel('position along membrane normal (A, 0 = centre of TM region)')
ax.set_ylabel('largest enclosed free radius (A)')
ax.set_title('Axial pore radius profile through the transmembrane bundle')
ax.legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False); ax.set_ylim(0,6)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
